title: BROKEN TERMINAL
objective: Exploit a stack buffer overflow vulnerability in broken_terminal to overwrite the return address and execute win().
technicalMechanism: The process_terminal function uses gets() to read into a 64-byte buffer. Overwriting 72 bytes (64 buffer + 8 saved rbp) allows controlling RIP and redirecting control flow to win().
hintLevels: Use objdump or GDB to inspect broken_terminal. Locate the win() function address and calculate the buffer offset in process_terminal.
The input buffer size is 64 bytes. Adding 8 bytes for saved RBP requires a 72-byte offset before overwriting the return address.
Construct a payload of 72 'A' bytes followed by the 64-bit little-endian address of win() to trigger flag output.

title: INTERNAL SERVICE
objective: Exploit a format string vulnerability to leak the secret authorization token from the stack.
technicalMechanism: The main function prints user input directly using printf(input). Supplying format specifiers like %5$lx leaks secret_token from stack slot 5, which can then be submitted to unlock grant_access().
hintLevels: Test user input with format specifiers like %p or %x. Notice that the program prints stack memory directly back to the terminal.
Locate the stack position of secret_token using specifiers like %5$lx or %6$lx.
Submit %5$lx as operator ID to leak the hex token 0xA02E11A99, then enter that token at the secret prompt.

title: AURELIA GATEWAY
objective: Exploit an unbounded read stack overflow in aurelia_gateway to execute win(0xDEADBEEF, 0xCAFEBABE).
technicalMechanism: The gateway_service function reads 256 bytes into a 64-byte stack buffer using fread. Solvers construct a ROP chain or argument payload targeting win(0xDEADBEEF, 0xCAFEBABE).
hintLevels: Analyze gateway_service in GDB or Ghidra. Note the win() address leaked in output and the 256-byte fread call into a 64-byte buffer.
Locate ROP gadgets (or set RDI=0xDEADBEEF and RSI=0xCAFEBABE) to pass the argument check in win().
Send 72 bytes padding followed by the address of win() with valid parameter registers to bypass the gateway check.
